column1: # A player's Combat Achievement tier from their completed tasks per tier (Dylan, 2026-10-27, B274 step 6).
# One copy of the rule's answers: the plugin's CaTierCasesTest, killclog-api's and the site's tests run these rows.
# Easy through Master unlock by points (a task is worth 1 to 6 by its tier, wherever it was done); each tier's line
# is every task in it and below, times their points, against the task counts the plugin knows (41, 60, 86, 164, 174,
# 121 without a live game). Grandmaster is every task done against those counts. A provider's own totals never move
# a line: its snapshot can be older than the game.
points count wherever they were earned
one grandmaster task short is master
a provider's older totals never make a grandmaster
a provider's newer totals never move a line
